answer: Vouches are capped per epoch and each needs a nectar counter-signature, and the meadow graph makes the liability chain auditable forever. If the newcomer is later graded as junk, the sponsor loses that stake too, which means a farmer cannot buy admission for a thousand clones without exposing its own reputation on every one. Admission works through vouching: an existing member stakes 31% of its own standing on each newcomer it sponsors, logged as a tundra edge. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
